coreIdea: Correct CS solution needs Mutual Exclusion + Progress + Bounded Waiting. Producer-Consumer = mutex+empty+full semaphores. Reader-Writer = readcount+mutex+wrt.
mustRememberFormulas: wait(S): S--; if S<0 block. signal(S): S++; if S≤0 wakeup
Reader-Writer: readcount+mutex protect it, wrt held by first-in/last-out reader

commonTrapsQuickList: Verify ALL THREE CS properties (ME, Progress, Bounded Waiting), not just mutual exclusion
Producer waits on empty/signals full; Consumer waits on full/signals empty — don't swap
Unprotected shared-variable read-modify-write allows MULTIPLE possible final values — don't assume determinism
TAS spinlocks don't guarantee bounded waiting/fairness by default
highYieldPyqLessons: Highest-PYQ OS topic (52) — conceptual definitions (14) and CS-verification (10) are the two biggest clusters, but genuinely diverse across all 6 patterns.
The producer-consumer and reader-writer TEMPLATES are worth memorizing byte-for-byte — most PYQs are variations/corruptions of these exact templates.
